description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter functionality within the OpenMRS project. It verifies behavior related to bean inclusion/exclusion based on OpenMRS version and module presence, using JUnit 5 testing framework.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter based on different OpenMRS platform versions and module configurations.

methods.name: match_shouldNotIncludeBeanForOpenmrsFrom1_6To1_7
methods.description: Tests that the bean OpenmrsProfile1_6To1_7 is not present in the application context for versions between 1.6 and 1.7.

methods.name: match_shouldIncludeBeanForOpenmrs1_10AndLater
methods.description: Verifies that the OpenmrsProfile1_10 bean is present when the platform version is 1.10 or later.

methods.name: match_shouldIncludeBeanForOpenmrs1_8AndLater
methods.description: Verifies that the OpenmrsProfile1_8 bean is present when the platform version is 1.8 or later.

methods.name: match_shouldNotIncludeBeanForOpenmrs1_8AndLaterIfModuleMissing
methods.description: Checks that the module OpenmrsProfile1_8WithHtmlformentry is not present if the module is missing.

methods.name: shouldBeIgnoredIfOpenmrsVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures that actions are ignored if the OpenMRS version does not match the expected version pattern.

methods.name: shouldBeIgnoredIfModuleDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures that actions are ignored if the expected module is not present.

methods.name: shouldNotBeIgnoredIfOpenmrsVersionDoesMatch
methods.description: Verifies that the platform does not ignore actions when the version matches.

methods.name: match_shouldIncludeBeanIfModuleMissing
methods.description: Tests that the bean OpenmrsProfileWithoutMissingModule is available even if some modules are missing.
